outlooks.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL OCCUR TODAY THROUGH TONIGHT FROM SOUTH-CENTRAL AND SOUTHEAST TEXAS INTO SOUTHWEST LOUISIANA. STRONG STORMS ALSO MAY OCCUR OVER PARTS OF THE GREAT BASIN AND NORTHERN ROCKIES.

sections.title: SYNOPTIC SETUP
sections.text: COMPLEX SPLIT FLOW WILL PERSIST OVER THE LWR 48 THROUGH FRI...DOWNSTREAM FROM UPR LOW OVER THE PAC NW. THE LOW SHOULD REFORM SSE INTO NRN CA BY THE END OF THE PERIOD AS LEAD SHORTWAVE IMPULSE NOW OVER ERN WA/ORE SHEARS NNE ACROSS ID/WRN MT...AND POTENT JET STREAK NOW W OF VANCOUVER ISLAND CONTINUES SSEWD. AS THIS OCCURS...EXPECT POSITIVE-TILT NM TROUGH TO CONTINUE E INTO WRN OK/TX THIS EVE...AND ENE INTO WRN MO/AR EARLY FRI...WHILE UPSTATE NY LOW MOVES E TO THE CANADIAN MARITIMES. AT THE SFC...FRONT NOW STALLED FROM DEEP S TX ENE INTO THE N CNTRL GULF OF MEXICO WILL BEGIN EDGING NWD TODAY IN RESPONSE APPROACHING UPR TROUGH. THE BOUNDARY'S NWD ADVANCE IN TX...HOWEVER...LIKELY WILL BE SLOWED BY SHOWERS/STORMS FORMING AHEAD OF THE UPR SYSTEM. IN THE WEST...COLD FRONT ATTENDANT TO PAC NW LOW SHOULD WEAKEN AS IT CONTINUES E/SE ACROSS THE NRN RCKYS/NRN GRT BASIN TODAY...AND LEE CYCLONE TEMPORARILY DEEPENS N OF THE BIG HORNS.

sections.title: S TX ENE INTO SW LA TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: CURRENT SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS FRONT THAT SETTLED S INTO DEEP S TX YESTERDAY IS BEGINNING TO EDGE NWD TOWARD LRD/CRP. FARTHER N... AN EXTENSIVE BAND OF ELEVATED STORMS EXTENDING ALONG THE I-35 CORRIDOR FROM S CNTRL THROUGH N-CNTRL TX LIKELY MARKS THE LEADING EDGE OF ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH NM UPR IMPULSE. THE ELEVATED STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE ENE TOWARD THE ARKLATEX LATER TODAY...WITH LITTLE RISK OF SVR WEATHER EXCEPT IN ITS SRN EXTENT GIVEN COMPARATIVELY LIMITED DEGREE OF ELEVATED BUOYANCY. FARTHER S...VWP DATA SHOW 925-850 MB FLOW ALREADY RESPONDING TO THE APPROACHING UPR DISTURBANCE...WITH SSELY FLOW HAVING STRENGTHENED TO AOA 30 KTS OVER S-CNTRL TX. ASSOCIATED INCREASE IN LOW-LVL WAA/MOISTURE TRANSPORT MAY BE SUFFICIENT TO INITIATE ISOLD TO WDLY SCTD DISCRETE CELLS LATER THIS MORNING OVER S TX AND THE S TX CSTL PLN ALONG AND JUST N OF WARM FRONT. WERE THIS TO OCCUR...ANY SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS WOULD POSE A CONDITIONAL RISK FOR SVR HAIL AND POSSIBLY A TORNADO GIVEN RICH MOISTURE /PW AROUND 2 INCHES/ AND SIZABLE LOW-LVL DIRECTIONAL SHEAR...REF MCD 651. A GREATER/MORE SUSTAINED SVR THREAT SHOULD EVOLVE THIS AFTN INTO EARLY TNGT OVER S TX AND THE SRN/MIDDLE TX GULF CSTL PLN AS SFC HEATING AND

sections.title: NRN GRT BASIN/NRN RCKYS THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: HEIGHT FALLS/ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH LEAD UPR IMPULSE...AND LOW-LVL UPLIFT ALONG ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT...EXPECTED TO SUPPORT A DIURNAL INCREASE IN STORMS FROM THE NRN GRT BASIN NNE INTO THE NRN RCKYS/NRN HI PLNS LATER TODAY. MOISTURE WILL REMAIN LIMITED... WITH PW AOB 0.75 INCH AND SFC DEWPOINTS RANGING FROM THE UPR 30S TO LOW 40S F. BUT COMBINATION OF FAIRLY DEEP/WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER WITH 35+ KT UNIDIRECTIONAL SWLY CLOUD-LAYER FLOW SUGGESTS THE POTENTIAL FOR STORMS TO ORGANIZE INTO BROKEN LINES/BANDS ALONG AND AHEAD OF THE FRONT. SOME OF THESE MAY CONTAIN SMALL BOWING SEGMENTS WITH BRIEFLY STRONG TO SVR WIND GUSTS AND/OR MARGINALLY SVR HAIL.

sections.title: ERN NY INTO CNTRL/NRN NEW ENGLAND THIS AFTN
sections.text: DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION BENEATH EWD-MOVING UPR LOW EXPECTED TO SUPPORT SCTD AFTN SHOWERS/STORMS FROM E-CNTRL/NE NY INTO PARTS OF NEW ENGLAND TODAY...WITH DEVELOPMENT LIKELY MOST CONCENTRATED WITHIN VORT LOBE ROUNDING THE BASE OF THE LOW. MOISTURE WILL BE LIMITED /SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW 40S F WITH PW AROUND 0.50 INCH/...AND DEEP SHEAR WEAK. BUT GIVEN 500 MB TEMPS AOB MINUS 22C AND STEEP BOUNDARY LAYER LAPSE RATES...SETUP MAY SUPPORT WDLY SCTD INSTANCES OF SMALL HAIL/STRONG SFC WINDS. ..CORFIDI/COOK.. 05/19/2016

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LARGE DAMAGING HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG WINDS MAY DEVELOP THIS MORNING IN A W-E ORIENTED CORRIDOR FROM DIMMIT COUNTY EWD TO THE COAST. A WATCH COULD BE REQUIRED DEPENDING ON STORM TRENDS OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE ANALYSIS AS WELL AS CRP RADAR SHOW A WARM FRONT LIFTING NWD ACROSS SRN TX WITH 70S F DEWPOINTS TO THE S. STRONG VEERING WINDS IN THE LOW-LEVELS ARE ALSO PRESENT. LIFT FROM WARM ADVECTION ALONE HAD PREVIOUSLY FAILED TO SUSTAIN EARLIER CELLS ACROSS WEBB AND LASALLE COUNTIES...ALTHOUGH BRIEF MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL CORES WERE PRESENT. THE STORM OVER DIMMIT COUNTY APPEARS TO BE AIDED BY LIFT ALONG A SWD SURGE OF COOLER AIR...AND POSSIBLY ENHANCED BY OUTFLOW WITH THE LARGER AREA OF STORMS. AS THIS STORM CONTINUES EWD...IT WILL ENCOUNTER STRONGER INSTABILITY NEAR AND N OF THE WARM FRONT. THIS COULD SUSTAIN IT WITH POSSIBLE UPSCALE GROWTH INTO EITHER A LARGE FORWARD-TILTING CELL OR SMALL BOW CONTAINING HAIL AND PERHAPS DAMAGING WIND GUSTS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE STORMS MAY YET DEVELOP WITHIN THE EASTERN PART OF WW 182 AS A CLUSTER PROGRESSES EAST AND PERHAPS ADDITIONAL STORMS FORM SOUTH. ISOLATED WIND/HAIL SHOULD REMAIN THE PRIMARY THREATS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A 35-KT EASTWARD-MOVING CLUSTER CENTERED OVER LIVE OAK COUNTY HAS SHOWN AN INTENSIFICATION TREND IN INBOUND VELOCITIES OVER THE PAST 20 MINUTES. THIS SUGGESTS POTENTIAL FOR STRONG TO ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS MAY BE INCREASING AS THIS APPROACHES THE MIDDLE COASTAL PLAIN GIVEN PRESENCE OF LOW-LEVEL EASTERLIES AND LOWER 70S SURFACE DEW POINTS. FARTHER SOUTH...WEAK SHOWERS APPEAR TO BE DEVELOPING NEAR THE CRP/BRO CWA BORDER. GIVEN SUBSTANTIAL VEERING OF THE WIND PROFILES WITH HEIGHT /PER CRP VWP DATA/ AND MODERATE BUOYANCY SAMPLED IN 12Z CRP RAOB /ALTHOUGH MUCH OF THIS WAS CONFINED TO THE UPPER PORTION OF THE PROFILE WITH MODEST LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES/...IT IS POSSIBLE THAT A STORM OR TWO MAY BECOME SEMI-ORGANIZED WITH A RISK FOR SEVERE HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG WINDS. ..GRAMS.. 05/19/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A RISK FOR ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL SHOULD DEVELOP WITHIN A SPATIALLY CONFINED CORRIDOR DOWNSTREAM OF WW 182. PROBABILITY OF DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE IS 40 PERCENT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 30-35 KT EASTWARD-MOVING CLUSTER WILL LIKELY SHIFT EAST OF WW 182 THROUGH ABOUT 18Z. LOWER 70S SURFACE DEW POINTS ARE CONFINED FROM GALVESTON BAY SOUTHWARD ALONG THE WEST/EAST-ORIENTED PORTION OF THE WARM FRONT THAT EXTENDS ACROSS THE FAR NORTHERN GULF. DOWNSTREAM CLOUD COVERAGE AND LEADING STRATIFORM RAIN IN SOUTHEAST TX WILL LIKELY LIMIT APPRECIABLE MOVEMENT OF THE FRONT NORTHWARD THIS AFTERNOON. THIS SUGGESTS THE THREAT FOR STRONG TO ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS WILL PROBABLY BE CONFINED TO A COUPLE COUNTIES INLAND FROM THE IMMEDIATE COAST.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE STORM OR TWO MAY DEVELOP PRIOR TO COMPOSITE COLD FRONT/CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BEING SHUNTED OFFSHORE BY ABOUT 23Z. LARGE HAIL SHOULD BE THE MAIN HAZARD. SPATIOTEMPORAL EXTENT OF THE RISK SHOULD BE TOO LIMITED TO WARRANT A WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COUPLE OF STORMS HAVE RECENTLY INTENSIFIED JUST AHEAD OF THE COMPOSITE COLD FRONT/CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW THAT STRETCHED FROM 35 WNW MFE TO 60 S CRP AS OF 2030Z. AIR MASS S OF THIS COMPOSITE BOUNDARY IS LIKELY STRONGLY UNSTABLE PER MODIFIED 17Z CRP RAOB WITH LOWER 90S TEMPERATURES AND 73-75 DEG F DEW POINTS AT THE SURFACE. A VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILE WITH HEIGHT MAY SUPPORT A SUPERCELL OR TWO WITH A MAIN THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL GIVEN THE DEGREE OF BUOYANCY. THE UNDERCUTTING NATURE OF THE COMPOSITE BOUNDARY SUGGESTS THIS RISK SHOULD BE SHORT-LIVED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED THUNDERSTORMS WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL AFFECT PARTS OF SERN LA AND SRN MS FOR THE NEXT COUPLE HRS. THESE THREATS ARE EXPECTED TO REMAIN TOO MARGINAL AND SHORT-DURATION IN NATURE TO PRECLUDE WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE TRENDS SHOW DEVELOPING THUNDERSTORMS ALONG A WEAKLY CONVERGENT AND NEARLY STATIONARY BOUNDARY NEAR I-10 ACROSS PARTS OF SERN LA. THIS IS OCCURRING DOWNSHEAR FROM THE NRN FLANK OF A MCS APPROACHING SWRN LA...AND SUFFICIENT HEATING/DESTABILIZATION HAS OCCURRED WITHIN A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER TO YIELD MLCAPE VALUES APPROACHING 1500 J/KG. MORE RECENT RADAR TRENDS SUGGEST THE POTENTIAL FOR HAIL APPROACHING SVR LIMITS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THESE STORMS...SUPPORTED BY THE PRESENCE OF 7-7.5 C/KM LAPSE RATES NOTED IN MORNING REGIONAL SOUNDINGS. LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS WEAK /PER LIX AND LCH VWP/...BUT STRONGER FLOW ABOVE 2 KM AGL IS YIELDING SUFFICIENT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES /30-40 KT/ TO MAINTAIN ORGANIZED STORMS. A FEW STRONG WIND GUSTS MAY ALSO DEVELOP GIVEN THE DIURNAL STEEPENING OF LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES THAT HAS OCCURRED...BUT THIS THREAT SHOULD REMAIN LOCALIZED. BOTH THE HAIL/WIND THREAT SHOULD PERSIST FOR THE NEXT 1-2 HRS...BEFORE GRADUALLY DIMINISHING WITH THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: VIGOROUS QLCS OVER THE NWRN GULF AND ASSOCIATED BOWING SEGMENT WILL LIKELY MOVE ASHORE NEAR THE MOUTH OF THE ATCHAFALAYA RIVER AND SUBSEQUENTLY MOVE EWD TOWARDS THE MOUTH OF THE MS RIVER OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. AS A RESULT...THERE WILL BE AN UPGRADE TO 15-PERCENT WIND PROBABILITIES AND CATEGORICAL SLIGHT RISK FOR THE 01Z OUTLOOK UPDATE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A QLCS LOCATED FROM 25 W OF LFT SWD TO 120 MI SSW 7R4 IN THE OPEN GULF WATERS IS PROGRESSING ENEWD AROUND 35 KT. THE AIRMASS DOWNSTREAM OF THE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM IS CHARACTERIZED AS VERY MOIST IN THE LOW LEVELS /LOW TO MID 70S DEWPOINTS/ ALONG AND S OF A MARITIME/EFFECTIVE FRONT LOCATED NEAR THE I-10 CORRIDOR. AN AN UPPER TROUGH OVER OK WILL MOVE ENEWD TOWARDS THE OZARKS THIS EVENING...AND FORCING FOR ASCENT AND STRENGTHENING DEEP-LAYER SHEAR PROFILES WILL OVERSPREAD SERN LA AS A RESULT. THE MAIN THREAT WITH THE SQUALL LINE WILL BE ISOLD WIND DAMAGE VIA 50-65 MPH GUSTS AND PERHAPS A MESOVORTEX OR TWO CAPABLE OF WIND DAMAGE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE WILL CONTINUE ACROSS SERN LA AND PROBABLY ACROSS COASTAL MS AND MOBILE BAY. A FAVORABLE ZONE FOR MESOVORTEXGENESIS MAY CONTINUE TO BE REALIZED ALONG THE EFFECTIVE FRONT FROM NEAR LAKE PONTCHARTRAIN EASTWARD ALONG THE MS GULF COAST. A NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH MAY NEED TO BE CONSIDERED BY 0400-0430Z FOR PORTIONS OF SRN MS AND SWRN AL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS A SEVERE QLCS WITH A NOTABLE NRN BOOK-END VORTEX 20 MI SW BTR. A WEST-EAST ORIENTED EFFECTIVE FRONT /ANALYZED VIA DEWPOINT GRADIENT AND STREAMLINES/ IS LOCATED FROM NEAR THE WESTSIDE OF LAKE PONTCHARTRAIN EWD ALONG THE MS GULF COAST INTO THE MOBILE BAY VICINITY. ALONG THIS CORRIDOR...WEAK LOW-LEVEL CONFLUENCE AND A MESOSCALE RIBBON OF STREAMWISE VORTICITY MAY BE OCCASIONALLY TILTED INTO THE VERTICAL AND STRETCHED---LEADING TO INTERMITTENT MESOVORTEXGENESIS. THE KLIX VAD DATA HAS CHANGED CONSIDERABLY THE LAST 2 HOURS WITH STRENGTHENING E TO SELY FLOW IN THE LOWEST 1 KM. THE VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WILL LIKELY SUPPORT A CONTINUATION OF THE QLCS INTO SRN MS AND SWRN AL DURING THE LATE EVENING TO OVERNIGHT HOURS. ..SMITH.. 05/20/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A THREAT FOR WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL CONTINUE FOR SEVERAL MORE HOURS AS A LINE OF STORMS MOVES EWD ACROSS SRN AL AND INTO THE WRN FL PANHANDLE. NEW WW ISSUANCE MAY NEED TO BE CONSIDERED TO THE EAST OF WW 184 AS THE LINE APPROACHES THE ERN EDGE OF THE WATCH EARLY THIS MORNING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST RADAR DATA FROM MOBILE SHOWS A WELL ORGANIZED BOWING LINE SEGMENT WITH A MESOVORTEX IN ITS WAKE. THIS QLCS IS LOCATED ALONG THE NRN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WHERE THE RAP IS ESTIMATING MLCAPE IN THE 1500 TO 2000 J/KG RANGE. IN ADDITION TO THE MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIRMASS...STRONG ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE MCV AND A 60 TO 75 KT MID-LEVEL JET ANALYZED JUST BEHIND THE QLCS...IS PROVIDING SUPPORT FOR THE ORGANIZED BOWING STRUCTURE. THE QLCS IS MOVING EWD AT ABOUT 45 KT WHICH WILL MAKE WIND DAMAGE LIKELY ALONG THE LEADING EDGE. THE SEVERE THREAT WILL CONTINUE FOR SEVERAL MORE HOURS ACROSS SRN AL AND INTO THE WRN FL PANHANDLE BUT MAY START TO BECOME MORE ISOLATED TOWARD DAYBREAK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE WIND DAMAGE THREAT ACROSS NRN FL AND SW GA IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MARGINAL OVER THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. FOR THIS REASON...NO NEW WW IS EXPECTED ACROSS THE REGION THIS MORNING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS A LARGE-SCALE BOWING LINE SEGMENT EXTENDING FROM ECNTRL AL SWD INTO THE NRN FL AND OFFSHORE INTO THE NERN GULF OF MEXICO. THE LINE OF STORMS IS LOCATED ALONG A GRADIENT OF INSTABILITY WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE UPPER 60S TO NEAR 70 F. THE EARLIER 60 TO 70 KT REAR INFLOW JET THAT WAS PROVIDING SUPPORT FOR ORGANIZATION WITH THE LINEAR MCS APPEARS TO BE WEAKENING. AS THE LINE MOVES EWD INTO WEAK INSTABILITY CURRENTLY IN PLACE ACROSS SW GA AND NRN FL...THE WIND DAMAGE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BECOME MARGINAL. ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
